---
title: "STORMBREAKER user guide"
output:
  rmarkdown::html_vignette:
    toc: true
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{STORMBREAKER user guide}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r guide, echo=FALSE, results='asis', purl=FALSE}
guide <- file.path("..", "inst", "guides", "user-guide.md")
if (!file.exists(guide)) {
  guide <- system.file("guides", "user-guide.md", package = "stormbreaker", mustWork = TRUE)
}
cat(readLines(guide, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")[-1L], sep = "\n")
```

```{r replay-scenarios, include=FALSE}
library(stormbreaker)
for (scenario in c("01-binary.R", "02-compare.R", "03-external.R",
                   "04-survival.R", "05-diagnostics.R", "06-shap.R")) {
  source(system.file("examples", "scenarios", scenario,
    package = "stormbreaker", mustWork = TRUE), local = TRUE)
}
```
